title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘Desert Sand’ applies a neutral beige finish to a scaled-down build made for little feet. Crafted from lightweight EVA, the one-piece upper features sculpted lines and a series of strategically mapped vents for increased airflow.
